description: Polyphonic sample and hold that adds a random amount to a control voltage

params.text: Picks a gaussian or a uniform distribution for the random amount
Sets how much random variation is added, working as a gain on the noise; at full it reaches 5V either way
A constant voltage added to the CV input, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: The voltage the random amount is added to; with nothing patched to the GATE input the module runs free and the CV output becomes a noise source
A rising edge here samples the CV input along with the spread and offset settings, and holds the result until the next one
Added to the SPREAD knob, a tenth of its range per volt; a polyphonic cable spreads each channel separately
Added to the OFFSET knob, a volt for a volt; a polyphonic cable offsets each channel separately

outputs.text: A copy of the gate input, carrying the same one-sample delay as the CV output so the two stay aligned
The held sum of the CV input, the offset and the random amount

menu: Low range spread (1/5) — cuts the range of the spread knob to a fifth, for finer settings
Max CV out and Min CV out — two sliders clamping the CV output; a red light comes on while it is clamping
Low range offset (1/3) — cuts the range of the offset knob to a third, for finer settings
